eyebrow: One value in, one value out
code:
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.ProductMargin
    (@ListPrice money, @StandardCost money)
RETURNS money
AS
BEGIN
    RETURN @ListPrice - @StandardCost;
END;
caption: Same shape as a BEGIN/END block, but it RETURNs one typed value.

code:
SELECT ProductID, Name, ListPrice, StandardCost,
       dbo.ProductMargin(ListPrice, StandardCost) AS Margin
FROM Production.Product
WHERE ListPrice > 0;
caption: Reads cleanly — but what does it cost under the hood?
